nodes.name: Davo settings
nodes.notes: Crew, ramp, the gates and the bring-list. Nothing else needs editing.

nodes.name: Wind forecast
nodes.notes: Open-Meteo. Free, no key. wind_speed_unit=kn so no conversion is needed.

nodes.name: Marine forecast
nodes.notes: sea_level_height_msl IS the tide. Not a model of one.

nodes.name: Score the window
nodes.notes: Wind + swell + tide must all be good in the SAME daylight run of hours.

nodes.name: Fishing reports
nodes.notes: No fishing-report API exists anywhere. Fetch the page, let the model read it.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model:'gpt-4o-mini', max_tokens:150, messages:[{role:'user',content: "Here is the HTML of a Western Australian fishing reports page. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no prose, no code fence: {\"species\":\"<the species most reported right now>\",\"spot\":\"<a named spot or ground if one is mentioned>\",\"depth_m\":<number or null>}. If the page does not say, use your knowledge of what is running off Perth this month. Keep species and spot under 6 words each." + '\n\n' + String($json.data || '').replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,'').slice(0,12000)}]}) }}

nodes.name: What is biting (GPT-4o)
nodes.notes: gpt-4o-mini is plenty for pulling two fields out of a page, and ~20x cheaper.

nodes.name: What is biting
nodes.notes: Falls back to a generic spot rather than stopping the trip.

nodes.name: Route to the ramp
nodes.notes: OSRM public router. Real roads, real drive time, free and keyless.

nodes.name: Fuel prices (FuelWatch WA)
nodes.notes: Real WA government API. 946 stations, today's price, lat/long on each.

nodes.name: Cheapest servo on the run
nodes.notes: Corridor filter, then cheapest. Prices come back in CENTS.

nodes.name: Price the run
nodes.notes: Back-times the alarm off the tide turning, not off sunrise.

nodes.name: Drop it in the boys chat

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, question: $json.poll_question, options: ["I'm in \u{1F3A3}", "Folding washing \🧺"], is_anonymous: false }) }}

nodes.name: Send the poll
nodes.notes: $credentials does NOT resolve in an HTTP expression - the token goes in the URL.

nodes.name: Save the trip
nodes.notes: The trip row is the handoff to workflow 2. Nothing stays open for a day.

parameters.content:
## 1. Is it on?
Wind, swell and tide from Open-Meteo. All three have to be good in the same daylight window or Davo stays quiet.

## 2. What's biting
There is no fishing-report API. We fetch a real reports page and let GPT-4o pull out the species and the ground.

## 3. The run
OSRM for the real drive. FuelWatch WA for the genuinely cheapest servo on the corridor - a real government API.

## 4. The call
Proposal + poll into the chat, and the trip is written to Supabase as `proposed` so workflow 2 can pick it up.

nodes.name: Poll answer
nodes.notes: Set this as the bot's webhook, or relay poll_answer updates into it.

nodes.name: Load the trip
nodes.notes: The handoff from workflow 1. No execution has to stay open.

nodes.name: Set the alarm
nodes.notes: You cannot write someone else's phone alarm. A calendar event with an alert does the same job.

parameters.content:
## Who's in
Everyone who taps **I'm in** gets their own brief: alarm, wheels-up, target species, their share, and the bring-list. Then the trip flips to `locked`.

nodes.name: Boat location
nodes.notes: OwnTracks in HTTP mode, or a two-line iOS Shortcut. Apple has no Find My API.

nodes.name: Call the pub (Bland.ai)
nodes.notes: No consumer booking API exists in AU. A real call is still automation.

parameters.text: =🍺 Beers are on. Table for four in {{ $json.eta_min }} min.

parameters.content:
## Heading in
Apple does **not** expose a Find My API and will not. OwnTracks (free, open source, HTTP mode) or an iOS Shortcut posts the same lat/lon to this webhook. Inside 8km of the ramp and closing, the pub gets a real phone call.

nodes.name: Webhook: a fish
nodes.notes: POST {angler, group_code, photo_b64}. base64, not a URL: OpenAI fetches a remote URL server-side and plenty of hosts refuse it (Wikimedia 400s it).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model:'gpt-4o', max_tokens:200, messages:[{role:'user', content:[{type:'text',text:"You are identifying a fish someone just caught in Western Australia. Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no prose and no code fence, shaped exactly: {\"species\":\"<common name>\",\"length_cm\":<number>,\"confidence\":<0-1>,\"note\":\"<max 12 words>\"}. Estimate length_cm from the fish's size relative to the hands, rod or esky holding it. If it is not a fish, set species to \"not a fish\" and length_cm to 0."},{type:'image_url',image_url:{url:$json.body.photo_b64 || $json.body.photo_url}}]}]}) }}

nodes.name: Identify the fish
nodes.notes: Verified live: a real photo returned sardine / 15cm / 0.9 for about US$0.0025.

nodes.name: Put it on the board
nodes.notes: Machine-only endpoint behind a shared secret, so nobody can type themselves a 90cm mulloway.

parameters.content:
## The board
Photograph the fish. GPT-4o names the species and estimates the length from whatever is holding it, and it lands on the live leaderboard before you have re-baited.
